title: Frankenstein at 18
hook: The scariest book ever written was started by an 18 year old stuck inside in bad weather.
caption:
1816 was the year without a summer. A volcano had put enough ash in the sky that Europe stayed under cloud, the crops failed, and Mary Shelley spent the whole of it indoors.

She started Frankenstein there. 18 years old, no plan, nothing going right, and she invented a genre.

I think about that every time I catch myself waiting for the right conditions. She did not have them either.

title: The turnip years
caption:
In Ireland and Scotland they carved turnips and beets. Small, dense, miserable to hollow out. Irish immigrants got to America, found pumpkins, and switched without a second thought.

The ritual survived because people let the tool change. Nobody was precious about the turnip.

Worth remembering when you are holding onto a version of something that stopped working. Link in bio.
